#+title: Golden journal lines, one per supported (type, event_version) (NS-08.B.001)

One file per =(type, event_version)= that =AiOrchestrator.Journal.Schemas.EventData= declares:
every type in =typed_types/0= crossed with =known_versions/1= (=1..current_version/1=, with
the per-type versions in =@versions=). =test/journal/golden_per_version_bytes_test.exs=
derives that list from the module and requires exactly these files, no more and no fewer.

Each =<type>.v<version>.jsonl= holds one journal line and a trailing newline. The bytes are
history: =golden.sha256.txt= pins every file, and a reader, upcaster or fold that rewrote one
would fail the byte comparison. A golden line is never edited; a new version gets a new file.

Provenance (source line copied byte for byte; "authored" marks the three reserved
notification types that no corpus carried, written against their payload schema):
